name: empty-states
title: Empty States
description: A set of empty-state panels sharing one framed product surface. Search shows did-you-mean terms and actions, the chart offers a Load sample data button, and other variants cover an inbox, uploads, a project board and activity.
use: A list, chart or inbox can be empty and needs copy, suggestions or a starting action instead of a blank screen.
avoid: It is an opinionated dark product panel with fixed internal layouts, so it is heavy for a one-line inline empty message.
a11y: Entrances respect reduced motion and buttons have focus rings, but the variant switch is plain buttons without tab roles or aria-selected. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded panel with a small title and meta line in its header, a Clear control at the right, and a centred icon above a heading, a line of grey guidance and one or two pill buttons. A segmented pill bar of six labels sits above; the chart variant draws dashed axes and light grey bars after loading.
behaves: The pill bar swaps variants with a crossfade. Entrances spring in once as the panel scrolls into view; the chart grows its bars when Load sample data is clicked, and hover or keyboard focus lifts the action buttons and suggestion chips.
customise: Only the variant and className are props; every heading, suggestion, button label and chart value is written inside the per-variant files.
weight: light: Six static panels with one-shot spring entrances and no loops.
